rationale: C07 is a direct and material drafting template for the child. Both are annual memoranda on the same nationwide Community Chest and United Fund campaign, and the child preserves C07's sequence: description and scale of the campaign, assurance of federal cooperation, appointment of George M. Humphrey as federal vice chairman, requested departmental cooperation, an almost identical list of solicitation and collection measures, and the same closing appeal. Several passages are reproduced nearly verbatim with updated figures and timing. C02 and C22 are earlier members of the same memorandum series, but C07 is substantially closer in language and structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: To assure the leaders of United Community Campaigns of America, representing local Community Chests and United Funds, of the cooperation of the Federal Government, I have approved the appointment of the Honorable George M. Humphrey, Secretary of the Treasury, as Vice Chairman for the Federal Government of United Community Campaigns.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have assured the leaders of United Community Campaigns of America, representing local Community Chests and United Funds, of the cooperation of the Federal Government. To this end I have approved the appointment of the Honorable George M. Humphrey, the Secretary of the Treasury, as Vice Chairman for the Federal Government of United Community Campaigns.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim language conveying the same assurance and making the identical appointment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am confident that you will extend the full cooperation of your Department in each community throughout the United States and its territories and possessions where it conducts its operations.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am confident that you will extend the full cooperation of your Department in each community throughout the United States and its territories and possessions where it conducts its operations.
shared_material.explanation: The operative request is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Such cooperation should include the effective solicitation of all employees, the acceptance of equitable unit goals, and the setting up of an adequate collection method for the convenience of those who wish to make contributions on an installment basis.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Such cooperation should include the effective solicitation of all employees, the acceptance of equitable unit goals and the setting up of an adequate collection method for the convenience of those who wish to make contributions on an installment basis.
shared_material.explanation: The child retains the same three-part administrative machinery with only punctuation differences.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is my hope that all employees will give generously--not because they must, but because they may--keeping in mind the wide variety and large number of organizations they will be supporting through their gifts to this single appeal.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is my hope that all employees will give generously--not because they must, but because they may--keeping in mind the wide variety and large number of organizations they will be supporting through their gifts to this single appeal.
shared_material.explanation: The closing appeal is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Many campaigns will include the needs of such national agencies as the Red Cross, USO, and those fighting heart disease, cancer, polio, tuberculosis, cerebral palsy and other health problems.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In addition, over 500 of these community campaigns will seek support for such national agencies as the Red Cross and those fighting heart disease, cancer, polio, tuberculosis, cerebral palsy and many other health problems.
shared_material.explanation: The campaign description preserves C07's distinctive list of national agencies and diseases while updating its details.
